name: In White
source:
Main character returns to his hometown for the first time in three years. He could not save a favorite girl in the traffic accident, and that wound lingers since then. His wish to get back to past is so strong that he is able to get there guided by a voice in the cherry blossom. This time he needs to protect the girl no matter what.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公时隔三年第一次回到故乡。他曾未能从交通事故中救下心爱的女孩，那道创伤自此一直留在心中。他渴望回到过去的愿望如此强烈，以至于在樱花中传来的声音引导下，他真的回到了过去。这一次，无论如何他都必须保护那个女孩。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-march-2002-kikokugai-cyber.html]vndbreview[/url]]
